business_problem: replace a managed Spark engine with a scalable governed platform that could analyze huge patient cohorts faster for a real-world clinical data application.
solution_summary: Sanofi uses Snowflake, Snowpark, and Snowpark Migration Accelerator on Snowflake to replace a managed Spark engine with a scalable governed platform that could analyze huge patient cohorts faster for a real-world clinical data application. Patient, clinical, claims, and research data are centralized in Snowflake so analysts, operators, and business teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpark keeps transformation and application logic close to the governed data instead of forcing the team to move workloads into separate compute environments. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Sanofi achieved 50% improvement in performance vs. previous managed Spark solution and 100M patient records per cohort, processed in four minutes on average.
